name: Travel time
description: Travel time to work in the morning and home in the afternoon, for up to three people, from travel-time sensors in Home Assistant (Waze Travel Time, Google Maps Travel Time). A delay against what is normal for that weekday and time shows as +x min. Hidden at the weekend if you like. Without a value from the sensor, the drive can come from the free OSRM service, using the work address. Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin. It can show the range of the car beside the commutes, in a strip.

cell_options.name: person_1_name
cell_options.label: Person 1: name
cell_options.help: Shown on the page. Blank uses the sensor's name. Kept as a secret, like the sensors: never in the page's markup or an exported template.

cell_options.name: person_1_to_work
cell_options.label: Person 1: to work
cell_options.help: A travel-time sensor in Home Assistant (Waze Travel Time, Google Maps Travel Time, or any sensor in minutes) from home to work.

cell_options.name: person_1_to_home
cell_options.label: Person 1: home
cell_options.help: The same, from work to home.

cell_options.name: person_1_work
cell_options.label: Person 1: work address
cell_options.help: Street, number and city of the workplace (or latitude,longitude). Used for a drive time from the free OSRM service when the sensor has no value, for instance while Waze Travel Time is down. Kept with the page, never in an exported template.

cell_options.name: travel_source
cell_options.label: Drive time from

choices.label: The sensor, and OSRM when it has no value
OSRM only (work address, no live traffic)

cell_options.help: OSRM is a free routing service with no live traffic: the drive then shows with a ≈ and without a delay against normal. It is sent your home position and the work address.

cell_options.name: home
cell_options.label: Home (for OSRM)
cell_options.help: A Home Assistant zone or device (zone.home), an address, or latitude,longitude.

cell_options.name: osrm_extra_pct
cell_options.label: Surcharge without traffic
cell_options.help: Added to an OSRM drive, which knows no traffic.

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout

choices.label: A strip: the blocks side by side (for a wide, low cell)

cell_options.help: The strip puts the car and each person next to each other, the minutes large, in a cell about 900 wide and 150 high.

cell_options.name: car_range
cell_options.label: Car: range
cell_options.help: In m, km or mi: shown in km, in a block of its own before the commutes. Leave blank for no car. All car sensors are kept as secrets.

cell_options.name: car_name
cell_options.label: Car: name
cell_options.help: Blank: the word for car in the widget's language.

cell_options.name: switch_hour
cell_options.label: Home from
cell_options.help: Before this hour the page shows the way to work, from it the way home.

cell_options.name: weekend
cell_options.label: At the weekend
cell_options.help: Hidden, the cell stays empty on Saturday and Sunday. For a page that gives the room to something else at the weekend, schedule a weekend page of its own.

cell_options.name: delay_min
cell_options.label: Show a delay from
cell_options.help: How much longer than normal before the page says so.

cell_options.name: baseline_weeks
cell_options.label: Normal is the median of the last
cell_options.help: Normal is the median of the same sensor on the same weekday at the same time of day, from Home Assistant's history (the recorder keeps 10 days by default: raise purge_keep_days, or the long-term statistics fill in). Until there is enough history the delay is left out.

cell_options.name: show_route
cell_options.label: Roads
cell_options.help: The road numbers of the route (A2 · A12), when the sensor gives them.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank: 'Travel time to work' or 'Travel time home' in the display language.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Language
cell_options.help: The widget's words in this language, whatever the dashboard's. Set the same on every widget of a page for one language throughout.
